name: feature.campaign-connectors.nodes
description: Campaign Connectors node pack — `import-csv` (parse a platform CSV export onto the unified metric schema with dedup + computed fields) and `sync` (ADR 0907 D3: a 7-day look-back of daily campaign metrics with conversions and revenue, for the dispatched campaigns or the whole configured ad account, read through the Connections broker via ctx.ads.getAccountMetrics — meta/google live; other platforms stay CSV-first with `connector_not_configured`). `dispatch-conversions` (ADR 0907 D7) delivers the queued server-side conversions on a schedule, re-checking consent per row at send. Over ctx.features['campaign-connectors'] + ctx.ads.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Connectors: Import CSV
nodes.description: Imports a platform CSV export into the campaign performance store (dedup by platform|campaign|adSet|date, computed metrics). Inputs: { orgId, csv, defaultPlatform?, campaignId? }. Output: { imported, deduped, invalid, issues }.

nodes.label: Connectors: Sync (live)
nodes.description: Pulls a rolling 7-day look-back of daily campaign metrics (spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, revenue) through the acting user's connection: the dispatched campaigns by default, or every campaign of the configured ad accounts when the org's connector settings (or the `syncScope` input) say `account`. Rows replace earlier pulls of the same day, so late conversions settle. 15-min cooldown; per-account best-effort; a page cap is reported as `truncated`. meta/google live; tiktok/linkedin readers exist but return `connector_not_configured` until the operator has verified them against the platform's test account (ADR 0907 D2); other platforms return `connector_not_configured`. Inputs: { orgId, platform, syncScope?: 'dispatched'|'account' }. Output: { outcome: 'synced'|'cooldown'|'no_dispatches'|'no_accounts', scope, since, until, campaigns, imported, deduped, failures[], truncated }.

nodes.label: Sync Segment → Ad Audience
nodes.description: Uploads a CRM saved segment as a hashed platform custom audience (ADR 0217): consent-checked, suppression-subtracted, SHA-256-hashed members via ctx.ads.syncAudience — behind the ads-audience approval gate (default require-approval; PII-adjacent). Inputs: { segmentId, platform: meta|google, adAccountId, audienceName? }. Output: { platformAudienceId, uploaded, excluded }.

nodes.label: Connectors: Push product feed
nodes.description: Pushes the org's product feed, generated from the commerce catalog (ADR 0952 D6), to Meta Catalog (items_batch) or Google Merchant Center (Merchant API) through the run owner's connections; they must hold workspace:write in the org. Only items whose content changed since the last push are sent, and items that left the catalog (deleted, inactive, or no image) are removed from the platform. Only real catalog images go in. A replay fork serves the recorded outcome and sends nothing. Unsupported until the push is verified on a test account; disabled until the org turns its feed on. Inputs: { orgId, platform: meta|google }. Output: { outcome, sent, unchanged, removed, failed, excluded, failures }.

nodes.label: Connectors: Deliver conversions
nodes.description: Delivers the org's queued server-side conversions to every live conversions API with an active pixel (Meta CAPI; TikTok Events and Google Ads uploads once verified on a test account). Runs as the run owner — their ad connections, and they must hold workspace:write in the org. Consent is re-checked per row at send: withdrawn ⇒ the row is dropped, unreadable ⇒ held for the next run. Resumable per row and per platform, so a retry never double-fires a platform. A replay fork serves the recorded outcome and sends nothing. Events older than a platform's window (Meta/TikTok 7 days, Google 90) are marked expired, never sent. OFF until the workspace enables the `campaign-connectors.scheduled-conversions` toggle (then `outcome: 'disabled'`, nothing read or sent). Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { outcome: 'delivered'|'disabled', sent, dropped, held, expired }.
